Now accepting applications from potential entrepreneurs or current business owners for the FORWARD Program, which could align you with your ideal franchise or business concept, provide you with resources to increase your knowledge and connect you with financing & retail/office space. Deadline to apply is 5 pm, Friday, April 12, 2019. For more information contact: [email protected] or call 918-445-4457. New schedule this year: FORWARD classes for new businesses will begin April 30 th and conclude May 21 st . FORWARD classes for existing businesses will begin June 4 th and conclude June 25 th . Classes for both sessions will be held Tuesdays from 6-9 pm, Participation in all classes is required. From growing up in the city to serving overseas and returning with a renewed sense of purpose, Ray’s path has always been shaped by service, community, and a desire to create opportunity for others. Rooted in Tulsa Ray’s story begins in Tulsa, but not in just one corner of it. “My experience growing up in Tulsa was unique,” he says. “Living in East Tulsa in the heart of the global district, spending time in North Tulsa schools, and graduating from Jenks, I learned to love the whole city.” That perspective, seeing Tulsa in its entirety, understanding its diversity and its
